pattern.description: The cursor hovers the 'Sheets' item in the open navigation drawer; the item highlights and a white submenu of sheet names appears beside it in a single step.
pattern.why_premium: Low premium value as recorded: an instant UI state change. Its job is wayfinding, showing the viewer the menu path to the P&L sheet the narration names next.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(sheetsItem, {backgroundColor: '#0a3fae', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power1.out'}).fromTo(flyout, {opacity: 0, x: -16}, {opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<').from(flyout.querySelectorAll('li'), {opacity: 0, y: 6, stagger: 0.015, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<0.05'); the source pops in instantly.
build_hint.remotion: flyout opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translateX = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 28, stiffness: 240}}), [0, 1], [-16, 0]); item highlight colour via interpolateColors over 3 frames.

notes: Energy is a single spike at the last burst frame, so the flyout is a hard state change in the source; any fade/slide is a suggested upgrade. Cursor travel is small and its start position is not clear in the filmstrip.
